title: Microsoft Viva: Interactive insights in Agent 365 Business Analytics
summary: The briefing's controls, preview behaviour and prerequisites are supported by Microsoft documentation, and its roadmap details match the record. One open question should describe March 2027 as a target rather than a settled availability date.

claims.claim: An API for Business Analytics access policies is not yet documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: "Business Analytics" "access policies" API Microsoft Graph PowerShell; site:learn.microsoft.com/graph "Business Analytics" "access". Opened manage/access and Viva manage-access-policies; no API for these app access policies found.

claims.claim: Viva feature policies are created in Microsoft 365 admin center at Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy.
claims.quote:
From the Microsoft 365 admin center, select Viva from the settings menu.
Select the Settings tab and select Manage feature access.
Select Create a policy.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId <featureId> -Name <policyName> -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-default disabling policy for the selected feature.
claims.quote:
Now that you have the featureID, use the Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy PowerShell cmdlet to create an access policy for the feature.
...
If you want to disable the feature for all users, use the -Everyone parameter instead.

claims.where: controls[1].governs and note; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: User-level export and insights controls user-level Interactive insights for leaders and managers; disabling it leaves aggregated insights only.
claims.quote: When off, leaders and managers can't export user-level data or view user-level insights on specific cards, and Interactive insights provides aggregated insights only.

claims.claim: User-level export and insights is always on for analysts and cannot be changed for that role.
claims.quote: Since analysts already have access to user-level data through advanced analysis experiences, the above-mentioned setting is always on for the analyst role and can't be changed.

Get-VivaModuleFeature -ModuleId VivaInsights

claims.claim: The Reasoning component can help users inspect how a request was carried out.
claims.quote: The Reasoning component is an optional view of work summaries and tool activity associated with a response. You don't need to follow it while Interactive insights works. Use it to check progress or audit how a request was carried out.

claims.claim: Microsoft suggests asking for a summary of data sources, methods and assumptions to audit an approach.
claims.quote: To audit an approach, ask: "Summarize the data sources, methods, and assumptions you used for this comparison."

claims.claim: Organisations can govern access and capabilities through applicable Microsoft 365 and Viva Insights controls.
